skill: Classify an explicitly given real number, or test containment of an entire named number set, among four scripted special sets.
learner_operation: Simplify a square root or fraction or recognize finite-decimal/pi irrationality; determine integrality, rationality and sign; interpret +, -, and zero subscripts; check each candidate membership or universal containment; report the exact subset using the supplied radio bank or independent checkboxes.
reasoning_steps: Identify whether the target is one number or all members of a named set.
Simplify the target when needed; classify sign and number hierarchy.
Evaluate every candidate including zero/sign restrictions; for universal claims use containment or a counterexample.
Select precisely the true candidates, or None if none qualify.
invariants: N={1,2,...} excludes zero, as tutorial 8214 explicitly says.
Superscript + or - is strict; a 0 subscript includes zero, as tutorial 8215 states.
Hierarchy N subset Z subset Q subset R subset C.
Four mathematical candidates; observed checkbox records sometimes add None of the above; radio records use a complete five-choice combination bank.
Easy workload: recognition and one elementary simplification, without complex arithmetic or set algebra.
permitted_variations: Change signs, finite decimals, integer-valued fractions, square and nonsquare radicands, pi and reciprocal-pi forms while retaining elementary classification.
Vary target named sets and candidate special sets from the taught table; derive subset truth from the target rather than retaining source labels.
Vary which candidate labels qualify, the number qualifying, zero membership, and order independently of presentation type when mathematically feasible.
Shuffle positions without using that alone as evidence of decision variety; preserve complete source answer banks at replay.
answer_roles: Target magnitude is often irrelevant within one sign/type class; target sign, rationality, integrality and zero can change correctness.
Candidate set base, sign restriction and zero inclusion determine correctness and are eligible answer-bearing assignments.
Radio correct combination and checkbox truth pattern must follow those assignments; source choices are examples, not invariant roles.
